source: CSG Consultants Laguna Beach Jurisdictional Data Sheet, ADU / JADU SPECIFIC rows 2-10
note: Items from the City plan-check data sheet for ADUs and JADUs, with how California ADU law treats each one.

decisions.item: PV required for a new detached ADU
decisions.outcome: State law already sets this rule; it is not a Laguna addition.
decisions.reason: The current California Energy Code already controls PV for newly constructed detached ADUs, with its own exceptions. Restating it as Laguna law would obscure those exceptions.

decisions.item: Sprinklers only when required for the primary residence
decisions.outcome: State law already sets this rule; it is not a Laguna addition.
decisions.reason: This is the exact statewide rule in Government Code section 66314(d)(12), not a Laguna-specific addition.

decisions.item: Full kitchen required, including sink, range, and refrigerator
decisions.outcome: Not enforced as a Laguna rule; state ADU law may preempt it.
decisions.reason: State law requires complete independent living facilities but the state floor does not impose this exact appliance trio. A refrigerator is not a permanent building provision, and the City source supplied no ordinance establishing an objective local standard.

decisions.item: Fire and sound separation; rated eave and exterior wall
decisions.outcome: Applies as an objective building, health or fire-safety standard.
decisions.reason: Objective building, health, and fire-safety standards remain applicable to ADUs; the city row points to the applicable CRC assembly tables rather than adding a zoning barrier.

decisions.outcome: Applies only when the design proposes a separate electrical service.
decisions.reason: CEC section 230.79(C) governs a one-family dwelling service, but it does not itself require an ADU to install a separate service. Converted section 66323(a)(1) ADUs cannot be forced into a new or separate utility connection. Apply the rating only when the design actually proposes a separate service.

decisions.item: Sewer and water connections optional, notes required
decisions.outcome: Applies; it is more permissive than state law.
decisions.reason: Optional connections are no more restrictive than the statewide converted-ADU protection and are more permissive for other ADUs. Plans must still identify the chosen connection approach.
